observations.detail: Verbatim interview statement and second claim retained; numeric possible-conflict quotes displayed.
Missing evidence triggers a dated-source follow-up; contesting triggers premise correction.
30-second deadline preserves draft and turn count; interruption and device reload preserve pending practice.
Retest uses original objection; debrief shows prior/current answers and recorded gaps without scoring.
Interview phase/answers unchanged; no practice POST or provider request; real debrief/CSV/coach/session downloads verified.
Hostile content rendered as text; dangling claim reference import rejected without replacing active state.
390px dialog has no horizontal overflow; keyboard focus stays inside; Escape returns focus to opener.
No uncaught browser errors across practice lifecycle.
